gap_candidates.description: Multi-account UX was surfaced before being canonically modeled — account widgets/auth panels exist but no 'requested_account'/'effective_account' fields exist in runtime/storage/schema contracts | Multi-account behavior exists in slices (provider/auth panels) but is not threaded through repo/project/worktree execution contracts — account identity must be end-to-end in all execution contracts | Not yet defined: how node retry memory, attempt handoff artifacts, reusable learning records, and worker handoff packets map into the seglog/redb/Tantivy stack — this gap must be resolved | Schemas stop at node-level modeling — acceptance/evidence/coverage/GUI automation/test schemas cannot represent work package, feature seam, lane, promotion class, contamination state, resolution threa… | package, seam, and work-package are 'schema ghosts' — they are assumed conceptually but absent from core schemas/receipts/event families; they must be made concrete
exact_missing_items: Multi-account UX was surfaced before being canonically modeled — account widgets/auth panels exist but no 'requested_account'/'effective_account' fields exist in runtime/storage/schema contracts
Multi-account behavior exists in slices (provider/auth panels) but is not threaded through repo/project/worktree execution contracts — account identity must be end-to-end in all execution contracts
Not yet defined: how node retry memory, attempt handoff artifacts, reusable learning records, and worker handoff packets map into the seglog/redb/Tantivy stack — this gap must be resolved

Schemas stop at node-level modeling — acceptance/evidence/coverage/GUI automation/test schemas cannot represent work package, feature seam, lane, promotion class, contamination state, resolution thread, or effective account identity; these must all be added
package, seam, and work-package are 'schema ghosts' — they are assumed conceptually but absent from core schemas/receipts/event families; they must be made concrete
